description: Add Proton-specific configuration fields to ProfilerConfig, mirroring Proton CLI flags through vLLM's --profiler-config interface

userStories.title: Add Proton config fields to ProfilerConfig
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Proton-specific fields in ProfilerConfig so users can configure Proton through --profiler-config JSON.
acceptanceCriteria: ProfilerConfig in vllm/config/profiler.py has field proton_profiler_dir: str (default '')
ProfilerConfig has field proton_context: str — 'shadow' or 'python' (default 'shadow')
ProfilerConfig has field proton_data: str — 'tree' or 'trace' (default 'tree')
ProfilerConfig has field proton_backend: str | None — 'cupti', 'roctracer', 'instrumentation', or None (default None)
ProfilerConfig has field proton_mode: str | None — free-form backend-specific string (default None)
ProfilerConfig has field proton_hook: str | None — 'triton' or None (default None)
All fields have docstrings explaining valid values
Existing torch/cuda config fields are unchanged
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Follow the torch_profiler_* naming pattern but with proton_ prefix. Refer to Proton CLI flags: -n/--name, -b/--backend, -c/--context, -m/--mode, -d/--data, -k/--hook. Proton source at submodules/triton/third_party/proton.

userStories.title: Add validation for Proton config fields
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the config to validate Proton fields so users get clear errors for invalid values.
acceptanceCriteria: When profiler='proton', proton_profiler_dir must be set (non-empty) — raises validation error otherwise
proton_context is validated to be 'shadow' or 'python'
proton_data is validated to be 'tree' or 'trace'
proton_backend is validated to be 'cupti', 'roctracer', 'instrumentation', or None
proton_hook is validated to be 'triton' or None
proton_mode accepts any string without validation (backend-dependent)
proton_profiler_dir is converted to absolute path (same URI scheme handling as torch_profiler_dir)
Validation errors produce clear messages indicating valid options
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Add validation in the existing @model_validator(mode='after') method. Follow the same pattern as torch_profiler_dir validation.

userStories.title: Wire Proton config into ProtonProfilerWrapper
userStories.description: As a developer, I need ProtonProfilerWrapper to read the new config fields and pass them to proton.start().
acceptanceCriteria: ProtonProfilerWrapper.__init__() reads all 6 Proton config fields from ProfilerConfig
_start() calls proton.start(name=..., context=..., data=..., backend=..., mode=..., hook=...)
Output file is written to proton_profiler_dir
Existing scheduling via delay_iterations, max_iterations, warmup_iterations, active_iterations, wait_iterations continues to work
Docstrings and inline comments explain each parameter mapping
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: ProtonProfilerWrapper already exists in vllm/profiler/wrapper.py. Update it to use the new config fields instead of hardcoded defaults. GPU worker profile() method in vllm/v1/worker/gpu_worker.py may need updating to pass new config fields.

userStories.title: Write tests for Proton config validation and wiring
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests that verify Proton config fields are validated and wired correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit test: ProfilerConfig(profiler='proton', proton_profiler_dir='/tmp/proton') creates valid config
Unit test: ProfilerConfig(profiler='proton') without proton_profiler_dir raises validation error
Unit test: invalid proton_context value raises validation error
Unit test: invalid proton_data value raises validation error
Unit test: invalid proton_backend value raises validation error
Unit test: invalid proton_hook value raises validation error
Unit test: proton_mode accepts arbitrary strings without error
Integration test: Proton config fields are correctly passed to proton.start() arguments
All existing profiler config tests continue to pass
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Existing test file at tests/v1/worker/test_proton_profiler.py. Add config validation tests there or in a new test file.

userStories.title: End-to-end validation with proton config options
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to validate that Proton config options work end-to-end with vllm serve.
acceptanceCriteria: vllm serve openai/gpt-oss-20b --profiler-config '{"profiler": "proton", "proton_profiler_dir": "/tmp/proton_output", "proton_context": "shadow", "proton_data": "tree", "proton_hook": "triton"}' starts without errors
Triggering /start_profile and /stop_profile produces profiling output in /tmp/proton_output
Output format matches proton_data setting (tree produces .hatchet file, trace produces .chrome_trace file)
Changing proton_context to 'python' produces Python-context profiling data
userStories.notes: The openai/gpt-oss-20b model requires --tensor-parallel-size 2 on 2x L40S GPUs. Server startup takes ~80s. Use proton_profiler_dir instead of torch_profiler_dir for the output directory.
